results.title: The Old Man and the Parrot
results.overview: With a taxidermy parrot and pistol in hand, Praxi, breaks into the home of a mute spiritual guru who trapped his lover’s soul inside the parrot years ago. Praxi must convince the guru’s estranged daughter to guide her father in freeing his lover’s soul in this darkly comedic tale of love and the afterlife.

results.title: London
results.overview: Bobby drives back and forth between Vienna and Salzburg, giving lifts to strangers on the way, sharing conversations that drift from the mundane to the deeply personal. In this tender portrait of today’s Europe, anonymity and warmth still go hand in hand.

results.title: Mr. Creamjeans' Hidey Hole
results.overview: Henry, a man plagued by chronic pain and unresolved guilt, receives a chilling message: "I know what you did." The note leads him to The Hidey Hole, an underground museum of erotic nightmares, curated by the charismatic and unsettling Mr. Creamjeans. There, Henry is offered a chance to erase all traces of his secret crime... but only if he submits to a guided tour of the museum's most depraved exhibits. With every tale, Henry's pain worsens and his grip on reality slips, until he's forced to confront the twisted role he's played in the lives (and deaths) of others. By the end, Henry must decide: confess the truth and face the consequence, or lose himself to the Hidey Hole forever.

results.title: Dead Man Memory
results.overview: David, a French police officer, travels to Thailand to meet Ravi – a young boy who claims to have been a criminal named Floyd in his previous life. Alongside his colleague Joanna, David enlists the young child and utilises his expertise to track down the dangerous criminal enterprise Floyd once had ties to.

results.title: Sing the World Better
results.overview: Chronicles ten weeks with Lauda - a pioneering youth ensemble within the internationally renowned Shallaway Youth Choir, one of only a handful of choirs in the world to embrace all neurotypes. As the choristers prepare for their end of season concert, they reveal the joyful harmony they’ve found together while navigating a world not always tuned to their rhythm.

results.title: We're Nothing at All
results.overview: On Valentine’s Day, a double-decker bus explodes in a fiery blast, killing many and leaving charred remains, with evidence pointing to a deliberate act by two passengers, Fai and Ike, a gay couple from troubled backgrounds living on society’s margins. As retired forensic expert Lung Sir investigates, he uncovers their tragic story of abuse, homophobia, and despair, culminating in their decision to end their lives in a suicidal protest against an unjust world, leaving behind a haunting message: “On a beautiful day, we end our unbeautiful lives.”

results.title: Scarecrow
results.overview: Anya takes the blame for her friend and becomes the target of bullying from classmates in the real world and on social networks.

results.title: Borderline
results.overview: A Norwegian customs officer, a Finnish poacher, and a mysterious Swedish woman meet at the border between their homelands, becoming entangled in a conflict over laws, language, and prejudice.

results.title: Long Shots: U.S. Biathlon’s Underdog Story
results.original_title: Long Shots: U.S. Biathlon’s Underdog Story
results.overview: Short documentary on the United States' 2026 Olympic Biatholon teams, covering their training and hopes to take home the first American medal in the sport.

results.title: Jetlee
results.overview: An attendant on a flight from Dubai to Kochi gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

results.title: Pripyat Piano
results.overview: 26 April 1986: Chernobyl’s reactor number 4 explodes and provokes the biggest nuclear disaster in history. Pripyat, where the plant is located, becomes a ghost city. Guided by former inhabitants, Eliška Cílková takes us in her quest of the town’s memory. Gracefully shot, the film reminds us the power of music where less expected.

results.title: Lakshmikanthan Kolai Vazhakku
results.overview: A young man convicted of murder awaits execution, while a conflicted judge, an aging hangman, and a morally torn jailer confront the weight of justice, guilt, and humanity in the final hours before dawn.

results.title: Zustìssia
results.overview: Set among the mountains of southern Sardinia, Zustissia reconstructs the 1991 triple homicide that led to Zuncheddu being sentenced to life imprisonment. He spent 33 years in prison before being definitively acquitted on 26 January 2024, following a retrial initiated by lawyer Mauro Trogu.

results.title: Chimney Town: Frozen in Time
results.original_title: 映画 えんとつ町のプペル 〜約束の時計台〜
results.overview: After losing his friend Poupelle, young Lubicchi wanders into a mysterious realm where a clock in a tower is frozen at 11:59. To return home, he must restart it – and find the courage to believe again.

results.title: Capio
results.overview: An amateur astronomer discovers a strange new star in the sky that leads him into the heart of a dark conspiracy to control humanity by exploiting its addiction to technology.

results.title: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 9
results.overview: The ninth night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 15, 2026, at Aimesse Yamanashi in Kofu, Yamanashi, Japan and featured two quarterfinal matches.

results.title: Milica Tomić
results.overview: On January 4th 1890, political activist Jaša Tomić murders Miša Dimitrijević, a reporter for the newspaper The Wall (Branik), for publicaly shaming his wife Milica several days prior, recieving a seven year long sentence in the process. Outraged, ashamed and marginalized, Milica, along with her newspaper The Flag (Zastava), decides to clear her name by improving the status and lives of women in the Austro-Hungarian regions of Vojvodina and Banat.
